items.basis: Polymarket 'next Opus by Jul 31' cooled to 84% (from 91%) after the rumored Jul 23 Thursday launch passed empty; Jul 24 now likeliest date at ~27%. Name unconfirmed.
Polymarket 'GPT-6 released by Dec 31 2026' ~87% (71% by Sep 30). GPT-5.6 shipping cadence pushes the numbered flagship to H2.
Google confirmed Jul 21 the flagship is still in partner testing — a fourth missed target; Axios Jul 23 flags the delay widening the race.
Moonshot promised full open weights for the already-live 2.8T Kimi K3 by Jul 27, amid White House distillation accusations.
V4-Pro/Flash preview live since Apr 24; no confirmed GA date. Legacy chat/reasoner API aliases retire Jul 24.
xAI (now SpaceXAI) shipped Grok 4.5 Jul 8; a next-gen Grok 5 is rumored but undated with no live market.
Google said Jul 21 that Gemini 4 pre-training has begun; no timeline or market yet.
